result.markdown:
# Traffic Drop in Sfax due to Fiber Link Failure

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-SFX-01-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarm evidence (LINK_LOS at 05:41) on the link, matching KPI and site outage timing, and maintenance started later.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-23 05:30 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-23 05:41
- **Affected:** S-SFX-003, S-SFX-005, S-SFX-007, LNK-SFX-01-B

## Summary

Fiber link LNK-SFX-01-B suffered a loss of signal (LINK_LOS), taking down downstream sites S-SFX-003, S-SFX-005, and S-SFX-007 ahead of planned maintenance.

Traffic drop and outages on three sites (S-SFX-003, S-SFX-005, S-SFX-007) in Sfax starting at 05:30/05:41 and ongoing.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-23 05:30: Region-level traffic alert ALR-0028 and availability drop started. [ALR-0028, ANM-000296]
- 2026-09-23 05:41: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on fiber link LNK-SFX-01-B. [ALM-000396]
- 2026-09-23 05:42: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on sites S-SFX-003, S-SFX-005, and S-SFX-007. [ALM-000397, ALM-000398, ALM-000399]
- 2026-09-23 07:04: Planned fiber splice work maintenance window MW-0008 officially began. [MW-0008]

## Evidence

- Sites S-SFX-003, S-SFX-005, and S-SFX-007 depend on fiber link LNK-SFX-01-B. [T2, S-SFX-003]
- Link LNK-SFX-01-B experienced a critical LINK_LOS alarm at 2026-09-23 05:41. [ALM-000396]
- Sites S-SFX-003, S-SFX-005, and S-SFX-007 went down at 2026-09-23 05:42. [ALM-000397, ALM-000398, ALM-000399]
- No configuration changes were found on the affected sites and their parents between 04:00 and 08:50. [T4]
- Maintenance window MW-0008 for fiber splice work started at 07:04, over an hour after the failure. [MW-0008, T9]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-SFX-01-B: confirmed. Direct LINK_LOS alarm occurred at 05:41 on LNK-SFX-01-B, causing subsequent site outages. [ALM-000396, T5]
2. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-SFX-01-B: rejected. Maintenance window MW-0008 started at 07:04, whereas the failure and impact started at 05:30/05:41. [MW-0008, T9]
3. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were recorded on the affected sites or their parents during the window. [T4]

## Ruled out

- MW-0008: Scheduled start time (07:04) was over an hour after the actual link failure (05:41).

## Recommended actions

- Investigate cause of early fiber cut on link LNK-SFX-01-B prior to scheduled maintenance window MW-0008.
- Verify restoration of fiber link LNK-SFX-01-B and monitor site recovery for S-SFX-003, S-SFX-005, and S-SFX-007.

report.title: Traffic Drop in Sfax due to Fiber Link Failure

confounders.why: A window on LNK-SFX-01-B that opens 84 min after the outage began; it covers only the repair, not the start of the outage.

truth.notes: trap=near_miss_maintenance; Fibre cut on LNK-SFX-01-B; all 3 downstream sites lost service until repair. The maintenance window opened 84 min after the cut, so the first 84 min of the outage are outside it and only the repair period is inside. Trap: a splice window on the right link covers the end of the outage (LNK-SFX-01-B), but the outage started well before it opened. Settled by: (1) LINK_LOS and SITE_DOWN were raised, and the sites were down, 84 min before the window starts, which fails the time test of the maintenance runbook; (2) the window closes when service returns, so it describes the repair, not the cause.
